issues.description: SQL Injection: User input keyword is directly interpolated into SQL query via template literal (${keyword}).
issues.suggestion: Use parameterized queries: const query = "SELECT * FROM todos WHERE title LIKE $1 OR description LIKE $1"; const rows = await db.query(query, [`%${keyword}%`]);

issues.description: SQL Injection: User input completed is concatenated directly into SQL statement (+ completed) without sanitization or parameterization.
issues.suggestion: Use parameterized queries: const sql = "SELECT * FROM todos WHERE completed = $1"; const rows = await db.query(sql, [completed === "true"]);

issues.description: SQL Injection: userId parameter in getTodosByUser is directly concatenated into SQL query string.
issues.suggestion: Use parameterized query: const query = "SELECT t.* FROM todos t JOIN user_todos ut ON t.id = ut.todo_id WHERE ut.user_id = $1"; const rows = await db.query(query, [userId]);

issues.description: Unindexed wildcard search (LIKE %keyword%) causes full table scans on large datasets.
issues.suggestion: Implement full-text search indexing or Trigram indexes for performant search.

codeQuality.summary: Severe security vulnerabilities identified. Multiple new search endpoints expose the application to devastating SQL injection attacks via unparameterized query interpolation.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Critical new search method lacks unit tests covering keyword matching, empty keywords, and SQL injection payload safety.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it("safely handles SQL injection payloads in searchTodos", async () => { const results = await searchTodos("' OR '1'='1"); expect(Array.isArray(results)).toBe(true); });

untestedPaths.reasoning: Status filter function requires tests for boolean strings ("true", "false") and invalid status inputs.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it("filters todos by completion status safely", async () => { const completedTodos = await searchTodosByStatus("true"); expect(completedTodos.every(t => t.completed)).toBe(true); });

untestedPaths.reasoning: User association search needs tests verifying isolation of user todos across different accounts.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it("returns only todos associated with given user", async () => { const todos = await getTodosByUser("user-123"); expect(todos).toHaveLength(1); });

testCoverage.summary: All three new search functions lack unit test coverage. Critical need for tests verifying parameterized query safety.

suggestions.description: Adopt parameterized queries repository pattern across all search endpoints.
suggestions.before:
const query = `SELECT * FROM todos WHERE title LIKE '%${keyword}%' OR description LIKE '%${keyword}%'`;
const rows = await db.query(query);
suggestions.after:
const query = 'SELECT * FROM todos WHERE title LIKE $1 OR description LIKE $1';
const rows = await db.query(query, [`%${keyword}%`]);
suggestions.benefits: Eliminates SQL injection vulnerabilities and allows database query plan caching.

suggestions.description: Accept boolean type for completed instead of loose string parameter.
suggestions.before: export async function searchTodosByStatus(completed: string): Promise<Todo[]> {
suggestions.after: export async function searchTodosByStatus(completed: boolean): Promise<Todo[]> {
suggestions.benefits: Strong type safety and eliminates parsing vulnerabilities.

refactorings.summary: Refactor search methods to enforce parameterized SQL execution and strict type signatures.

recommendations.description: BLOCK MERGE: Immediately replace all direct string concatenations in search queries with parameterized placeholders ($1, $2) to eliminate SQL injection vulnerabilities.
Implement unit tests validating SQL injection resilience and search results filtering in tests/todo.test.ts.
Update searchTodosByStatus parameter from string to boolean.
